info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API allows users to efficiently remove items from their shopping cart, streamlining the management of a user's selected products. This operation is crucial for maintaining an accurate shopping experience and ensuring that users can adjust their purchase decisions seamlessly. It targets the shopping cart resource within the ecommerce platform, enabling consumers to modify their cart contents as needed. Typical users of this API include ecommerce platforms, mobile apps, and third-party integrations looking to enhance user convenience in online shopping.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This operation allows the user to remove a specified item from their shopping cart, updating the cart accordingly. It is important to ensure the item exists in the cart before removal.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to define the details for removing an item from the cart. Please provide the necessary information as specified in the schema.

200.description: The item was successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for removing an item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cart removal was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for tracking the removal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the removal operation.

state.description: Current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cart removal in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: Response schema for the cart removal operation indicating the status and details of the removal process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: User who initiated the cart removal operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cart removal operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cart removal operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for the cart removal operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A lower value indicates a quicker response time. This value can help in assessing server performance.
